description: **Blog functionality moved to selfblog.** Post discovery, post checks (POST001-POST005), and the unified multi-project check now live in the `selfblog` package. `selfdoc post`/`selfdoc assembly` commands temporarily delegate to selfblog (install with `pip install selfblog`); `selfdoc check` on unified projects now hard-errors and directs to `selfblog check`. New `selfblog check` command validates posts and unified sites.
